data.name: Snehalata
data.long_meaning: A name derived from Sanskrit, Sneha (heart) and Lata (bound). Snehalata means one who is heart bound, attached to love. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a goddess who embodies love and compassion. She is believed to nurture and protect the emotional bonds between loved ones.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nurtures emotional bonds and embodies love and compassion
